subject: Compliance add-ons: HSM seats, residency amortization & split-payment request
messages:
From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@pulselabs.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Alex Carter <alex.carter@pulselabs.ai>
Cc: contracts@pulselabs.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Compliance add-on pricing: HSM seats, residency, and amortization

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we start scoping the pilot we need a clearly itemized cost for the compliance add-ons (audit logs retention, KMS/HSM seats, and EU residency for a subset of users). A few constraints from our finance team:

- We have a capital constraint this quarter and would prefer to amortize large one-time implementation/residency charges over 12 months if possible.
- Pulse Labs is asking whether HSM seats can be treated as an upfront hardware-like charge and split across FY27, or alternatively offered as a recurring seat fee.
- We need a redline-friendly SOW so our legal team can start their review.

Can you send an itemized worksheet showing both (a) upfront price + 12-month amortization schedule, and (b) a fully-recurring model (monthly) so we can compare TCO? Also: any flexibility on a small pilot credit for audit log ingestion during the first 90 days would help get exec buy-in.

Attaching our internal risk assessment for reference (Pulse_Risk_Assessment.xlsx).

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call too.

— Nina
Nina Patel
Head of Security, Pulse Labs
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@pulselabs.ai>
Cc: Alex Carter <alex.carter@pulselabs.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Dec 2026 12:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Compliance add-on pricing: HSM seats, residency, and amortization

Hi Nina — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear asks. I pulled together two options and attached a worksheet for comparison (Redwood_Compliance_Pricing_worksheet.xlsx) plus a draft SOW to accelerate legal review (SOW_PulseLabs_v1.docx). Highlights:

Option A — Upfront + Amortized:
- HSM seat setup (one-time): $120k (we can show a 12-month amortization in the worksheet)
- EU residency setup (one-time): $45k
- Audit log ingestion (recurring): $0.025/GB ingested after pilot
- One-time implementation fee: $18k

Option B — Fully-recurring:
- HSM functionality as recurring seats: $10k/mo per seat
- EU residency as region surcharge: $6k/mo
- Audit logs recurring as above

Pilot credit: we can offer a $12k pilot credit applied against the implementation fee or first two months of recurring charges — subject to a 6-month minimum commitment on the core API usage.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal alignment on concession authority (looping in Finance & Pricing) — cc'd Hannah and David.
2) If we agree, I’ll send a formal counterproposal with explicit amortization schedule + DocuSign link.
3) Optional quick call with engineering to confirm HSM provisioning lead time.

If you want, we can set the call for Wed morning PST.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Fw: Compliance add-on pricing: HSM seats, residency, and amortization

Laura — forwarding Nina's note. Quick questions for finance: what headroom do we have on offering a pilot credit + amortization without escalating to VP? They specifically want a 12-month amortization of the upfront residency & HSM setup. Also want to understand any revenue recognition implications if we do a one-time credit vs recurring discount.

Can you run numbers for two scenarios: (1) $120k HSM + $45k residency amortized over 12 months with a $12k pilot credit applied to implementation; (2) convert both to recurring and discount the first 3 months by 50% as the pilot incentive. Need to know net ARR impact and approved up-front concession (if any).

— Hannah
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fw: Compliance add-on pricing: HSM seats, residency, and amortization

Hannah / team — ran the quick finance model. Notes and recommendation below (also saved in pricing_working_notes.md):

Scenario 1 (Amortized upfront):
- HSM one-time: $120,000 -> amortized 12 months = $10,000/mo recognized as deferred revenue release for accounting (we’ll need SOW language to match deliverable schedule)
- EU residency one-time: $45,000 -> $3,750/mo
- Pilot credit: $12,000 applied to implementation (reduces cash collected on signing; we can structure as a contra-revenue credit)
- Net impact to ARR first 12 months: minimal if they commit to minimum monthly API usage; one-time reduces upfront cash but spreads recognition

Scenario 2 (Fully recurring):
- HSM seat: $10,000/mo per seat (recognized as ARR)
- EU residency: $6,000/mo
- Suggestion: offer first 3 months at 50% as pilot incentive rather than a large up-front credit — simpler for revenue recognition and keeps ARR profile clean

Recommendation: Approve amortization option to meet Pulse Labs' budget constraints but cap concession to a single $12k pilot credit and require a 6-month minimum API commit and a 12-month term on the compliance add-ons. That preserves revenue runway and simplifies collection. We can allow the customer to choose amortized one-time fees or recurring pricing in the SOW, but discounts/concessions must be approved at no more than $15k without VP sign-off.

— Priyom
Finance — Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@pulselabs.ai>
Cc: Alex Carter <alex.carter@pulselabs.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: Pulse Labs compliance add-ons (counterproposal attached)

Hi Nina —

Thanks for the patience — we’ve aligned internally and attached a formal counterproposal that includes two pricing tracks and an amortization schedule (see Redwood_Compliance_Pricing_worksheet.xlsx and SOW_PulseLabs_v1.docx). Summary below:

Track A — Amortized Upfront (recommended by Pulse):
- HSM setup (one-time): $120,000 (amortized = $10,000/mo for 12 mo)
- EU residency setup (one-time): $45,000 (amortized = $3,750/mo for 12 mo)
- Implementation fee: $18,000 (pilot credit $12,000 applied -> net $6,000 upfront)
- Audit logging ingestion: $0.025/GB after pilot (first 90 days free up to 500GB)
- Term: 12 months for add-ons; 6-month minimum on core API usage (as finance requested)

Track B — Fully-recurring:
- HSM seat: $10,000/mo per seat
- EU residency: $6,000/mo
- Pilot incentive: first 3 months at 50% off recurring charge for add-ons

Commercial notes / constraints:
- Pilot credit capped at $12k and contingent on executed SOW within 14 days.
- Any concession > $15k requires VP approval (per finance).
- HSM lead time: ~6 weeks from signed SOW; David will coordinate provisioning and will reach out separately on technical dependencies.

If this looks acceptable, I’ll upload the DocuSign envelope and route the SOW to contracts@pulselabs.ai. Proposed next step: sign SOW + schedule kickoff the week of Dec 20.

Attachments: Redwood_Compliance_Pricing_worksheet.xlsx, SOW_PulseLabs_v1.docx

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@pulselabs.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Carter <alex.carter@pulselabs.ai>, contracts@pulselabs.ai
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: Pulse Labs compliance add-ons (counterproposal attached)

Laura — thanks for the clear options and for looping finance in. Pulse Labs prefers Track A (amortized upfront) — the 90-day free ingestion cap helps. We’ll take the SOW to legal and expect to return redlines within 48 hours. Please send the DocuSign link and we’ll route to our procurement team (cc'ed).

I’ll also set up a 30-minute technical call with David next week to go over HSM provisioning windows and expected keys rotation cadence.

— Nina
